title: tab/permissionAnswer
description: Shell-to-engine notification: allow or deny every permission of a tab/permission prompt (PermissionPromptCallback::Continue with accept or deny; MediaAccessCallback::Continue with the requested permissions or Cancel). An answer for a prompt that is gone is ignored. tab/dialogClosed follows.

tab.description: The tab's id, as tab/create answered it ("1", "2", ...; never reused in one engine process).
